title: Risk Prediction in Type II Diabetics With Ischemic Heart Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test whether cardiac autonomic dysfunction predicts is a prognostic marker in type-2 diabetics with ischemic heart disease
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type-2 diabetes
* coronary artery disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* age \>80 years
* acute coronary syndrome
* life expectancy \<1 year
* unable to give informed consent
study_population: Consecutive patients with diagnose of ischemic heart disease and type-2 diabetes are included.
